baseline.budget_rule: modes54 budget rule (restated): plain-PyTorch TinyTransformer (2 layers, d_model 64, 4 heads, FFN 128, word-level vocab over all demo texts, positional table widened 512->768 to fit the 600-token story), full-batch Adam lr 1e-3, grad-clip 1.0, exactly 600 fixed updates, seeds 5401/5402/5403 reported separately and never averaged, greedy decode <= 8 tokens, exact match after word normalization. Q10 training = one full-batch next-token sequence over the byte-identical 120 teaching lines the notebook heard; the same 20 questions are asked only at evaluation (never trained on). Q11 frozen = zero updates after Q10 training; Q11 fine-tune = fresh Adam lr 1e-3, full-batch next-token LM on the 5 new teaching lines, updates until wall-clock >= the notebook's Q11 beat (minimum 1 update).
